collections: 08 TRIM LIGHTS DATUMS AND ENGINEERING NOTES

props.status: sealed reference exterior and load path CAD only, not CFD or FEA qualified
props.parent_model: VTX Phantom original black-and-amber design sheet
props.mission: VTOL and rolling takeoff+landing; 200 mph road target, 400 mph flight target
props.purpose_of_canards: restore nose-up moment during transition to moving wheel landing
props.current_revision: NO WINGS OR CANARDS INSTALLED: capped root mount stations pending aero pressure assessment
props.flight_coefficient_assumptions: NOT fitted; must calculate CL(alpha), CD(Mach), CG static margin, pressure map
props.materials: CFRP structural skins/sandwich, Ti6Al4V bearing clevises, 7050 alloy removable service points
props.coordinate_transform_required: model X forward, Y lateral, Z up; flight simulator ENU transform before import
props.nonverified: weight, joints, load path strength, FEM, airtightness, Cfd boundary geometry, thermal and airflow
props.silhouette_reference: original VTX Phantom concept sheet: low sharp nose, angular flared wheel haunches, black & amber, twin fins, folding swept wings
props.A6_goal: match original identity, not a generic round-nosed high-performance car
props.aero_status: closed reference external hull only; CFD, pressure distribution, canard moments not yet computed
props.wing_geometry_status: folding visual envelopes; wing profile to be sized with CFD
props.ground_clearance_geometry: to test swept wheel envelope, leg position and all airflow modes
props.seat_arrangement: single row side by side, driver/passenger; no second row
props.occupant_payload_budget_kg: 2 x nominal 90kg placeholder; includes occupant and carried items
props.roofline_policy: do not increase exterior height for occupant count
props.control_interface: fly-by-wire controls: cockpit includes direct front console
props.future_cabin_fit: verify H point, ingress/egress, legroom, head clearance with human models before build approval
props.A8_Cooling_vent_interfaces: 2 rear engine intakes, 2 radiator intakes, 4 wheel brake inlets, 4 wheelhouse pressure-relief outlets
props.aerodynamics: do NOT claim stability from vents: symmetric placement only, requires CFD across yaw and AOA envelope
props.airflow_hover: fans mandatory where needed; zero ram pressure at stationary VTOL
props.engine_type: still TBD; air intake geometry optional for electric architecture; refrigerant loop alternative
props.reference_version: A8 angular Phantom body with ported shell
props.thermal_system: no CFD, no heat exchanger effectiveness or energy sizing performed yet
